sample.question_description: Predict watered crops after toggling listed valves.
sample.question_preview: Toggle each valve shown in the toggle cards once. Which crop labels will be watered afterward? Options: [1] A, B [2] none [3] D [4] A [5] C [6] B
sample.question:
Toggle each valve shown in the toggle cards once. Which crop labels will be watered afterward?
Options:
[1] A, B
[2] none
[3] D
[4] A
[5] C
[6] B
sample.analysis: Current valves are {'V1': False, 'V2': False, 'V3': True, 'V4': False}. After toggling ['V3', 'V4'], the valves become {'V1': False, 'V2': False, 'V3': False, 'V4': True}. Water reaches crop labels ['none']. Therefore choose option 2.

state_content.rules: Water starts at pump P and follows connected pipes. A pipe segment controlled by a valve carries water only when that valve is open. Water can split at junctions.
